purpose: Golden demo and acceptance set for the deployed research model. Text-only: it names samples, questions, gold answers and this release's frozen predictions, and contains no imagery.

source.section: 3. Philadelphia predicted-soft 正反案例（corrected grouped evaluator）
source.authority: Listed in this release's model-release.json evidence_references.
source.sampling_rule: Not hand-picked: ordered by sample ID, first unused image per correctness stratum and per type order area -> count -> comp -> presence.

image_acquisition.reason: RSVQA-HR imagery is not present in this repository and is not redistributable here. Only the frozen sample identifiers are recorded.
image_acquisition.remote_location: RSVQA-HR raw corpus on the research host (see rs-vqa-fusion/scripts/download_rsvqa_hr.sh)

usage_boundary: These 8 samples are a wiring and parity check, not an accuracy measurement.
Approved accuracy figures come only from the full-split evaluation recorded in model-release.json approved_metrics.
8 samples cannot support any accuracy, comparison or SOTA claim.
expected_prediction is what this frozen checkpoint produced, not what a correct answer would be; two of the eight are recorded as incorrect.

samples.question: What is the area covered by commercial buildings?
What is the number of commercial buildings?
Are there less residential buildings than roads?
What is the area covered by residential buildings?
What is the amount of roads?
Are there more roads than residential buildings?
